title: 59 Barcelona Avenue | 6BR Rental on Seagrove Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 59 Barcelona Avenue is a signature 6BR Seagrove Beach estate featuring a private pool and carriage house. This luxury rental sleeps 14 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: Seas the Day - Seagrove by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 59 Barcelona Avenue, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Experience a luxurious vacation retreat nestled in the heart of 30A. Seas the Day offers more than just a place to stay; it provides an unforgettable getaway for up to 14 guests. With six bedrooms and six and a half bathrooms, there’s ample space and comfort for everyone to enjoy. Step into this beautifully designed home, perfect for family reunions or gatherings with friends. Seas the Day is more than just a delightful name; it embodies the essence of relaxation and rejuvenation. The thoughtful layout fosters a welcoming atmosphere where lasting memories are made. After a day soaking up the sun, unwind in this haven featuring spacious interiors and exquisite private accommodations. Venture beyond the inviting indoors to discover your personal oasis, complete with a sparkling pool ideal for leisurely swims or playful splashes. Nearby, the beach awaits, where you can build sandcastles with the kids, enjoy long walks along the shore, or simply bask in the sun’s warmth. Be sure to explore the nearby charming village of Seaside! Seas the Day in Seagrove is your portal to an extraordinary vacation experience, artfully blending comfort and adventure. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach: 340 yards - *Private Pool - All En Suite - Carriage House - Newer Construction - Professional Décor - Secondary Family/Media Room * Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). * The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. * Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 6 Bedrooms / 6 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath / 1 Beach Shower First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Suite with Private Bath (Vessel Tub, Separate Shower), Smart TV - Open Concept Great Room Including Living, Kitchen, Dining, Covered Porch with Seating, Half Bath, Laundry - Pool Courtyard, Private Pool, Half Bath, Outdoor Living, Beach Shower Second Floor: - Bedroom 2: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV - Bedroom 3: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV - Bedroom 4: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV - Bedroom 5: Bunk Room (Two Twin/Queen) with Private Bath - Media Room Carriage House: - Bedroom 6: Full Suite with Private Bath - Full Kitchen and Living Amenities: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
